description: Represents a single cell within a spreadsheet sheet.

members.name: Clone
members.description: Creates a deep copy of this cell including style.

members.name: DataType
members.description: The data type of the cell value.

members.name: DisplayValue
members.description: The computed or formatted display value. Null until evaluated.

members.name: Formula
members.description: The formula expression (e.g. =SUM(A1:A10)). Null if the cell has no formula.

members.name: Hyperlink
members.description: A structured hyperlink attached to this cell.

members.name: ImageUrl
members.description: An image URL or base64 data to render inside the cell.

members.name: IsReadOnly
members.description: Whether the cell is read-only and cannot be edited.

members.name: Style
members.description: The visual style of the cell.

members.name: Validation
members.description: The data validation rule that applies to this cell (shared reference from the sheet).

members.name: Value
members.description: The raw value stored in the cell.
